tests.name: Radio explicitly hides decorative descendants from accessibility

checks.description: Accessible radio root uses label/default hint unless caller overrides, retains unrelated caller state, owns disabled/checked/selected; disabled is unfocusable and cannot activate.

Native Pressable pointer/keyboard activation and confirmed root ref focus work, disabled skips Tab; system rings Windows/macOS versus persistent keyboard-modality Win32 custom ring obey shared policy/lifetime.
Narrator/VoiceOver announces one named radio with availability and owned selection, not decorative descendants; group name/peer navigation remain owner responsibilities.

limitations: Public-contract paragraph says descendants rely on root grouping, but platform section and resolved divergence require explicit hiding; mapping follows the resolved requirement.
UIA radio uses SelectionItem rather than Toggle; checked prop alone does not establish native Select transport.
No group navigation, cross-endpoint action projection or screen-reader qualification is inferred from standalone unit tests.
